## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      6 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Nov 10, 2026 - Nov 20, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Syne612_, Nov 20, 2026, 1/5: "This most recent update is a slap in the face to people who have been dedicated users, especially after assuring us that you wouldn’t do this exact thing after purchasing Anki… this vibe coded piece of garbage doesn’t even have a delete card button anymore…. Realize there are fifty cards that you need to delete? Guess you’re deleting them one by one because selecting then deleting notes no longer available. I literally don’t think there are enough characters available in this update for me to go over every single bug that has been introduced. I’ve been a programmer for the past 10 years, and a majority of my work has been done in the front end. I also am the creator of some of the most used programming decks on Anki… so when I say that I am a UI expert I’m not just blowing smoke. This new update deserves zero stars from a UI standpoint. You would then have to give it negative stars for all the bugs that have been introduced."
            2. _Vdkxn_, Nov 12, 2026, 1/5: "Can’t find my cards in search at all, can’t delete cards from search anymore, front page now has tons of wasted free space so I have to scroll to see my decks, also since updating my app crashes occasionally, that didn’t happen before"
            3. _wwx.exe_, Nov 10, 2026, 1/5: "I love anki, but the new UI sucks. It's buggy and it changed all of our habits and muscle memory. Anki's UI has always been a bit cluttered and there was a learning curve, but now it's completely different again and I feel like I need to relearn how to use the app. Please put a toggle to deactivate the new UI somewhere."
<!--/ir-theme-->
